title: stop hook blocks the host session after sprint-start when the phase is meant for prusik drive, which has not started yet
detail: 2026-11-19: ran prusik gate sprint-start lease-lifecycle in a session to hand off to prusik drive from a plain shell (the documented flow). The Stop hook then blocked the session on scoping's exit artifacts (scope.md, scope-approval.txt), which drive's scoping produces. fb-5861062129e7 exempts a live drive or delegated role; nothing covers the gap between sprint-start and drive starting. Same hand-off as fb-ff93b3641749.
